name: 请假审批-表单版
bpmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!--
  请假审批流程（示例简化版）。
  key=leave-bill。
  节点：提交（发起人，startProcess 后由 InitiatorNodeResolver 自动完成）
       → 部门经理审批（示例简化：assignee 固定取流程变量 manager）
       → 结束。
  包含 BPMNDI 图形信息（节点坐标/尺寸 + 连线 waypoints），
  供 bpmn-js / 流程跟踪页渲染高亮流程图。
-->
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
             xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
             xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
             xmlns:flowable="http://flowable.org/bpmn"
             targetNamespace="example">

  <process id="leave-form-flow" name="请假审批-表单版" isExecutable="true">

    <startEvent id="startEvent" name="开始" />

    <!-- 提交节点：发起人节点（InitiatorNodeResolver 据此自动完成） -->
    <userTask id="submitTask" name="提交请假" flowable:assignee="${initiator}">
      <documentation>发起人提交节点，流程启动后自动完成；SUBMIT 任务变量 submitterId</documentation>
    </userTask>

    <!-- 部门经理审批：示例简化，assignee 固定取流程变量 manager -->
    <userTask id="managerApproval" name="部门经理审批" flowable:assignee="${manager}">
      <documentation>部门经理审批节点（示例简化：审批人取流程变量 manager）</documentation>
    </userTask>

    <endEvent id="endEvent" name="结束" />

    <sequenceFlow id="flow1" sourceRef="startEvent" targetRef="submitTask" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow2" sourceRef="submitTask" targetRef="managerApproval" />
    <sequenceFlow id="flow3" sourceRef="managerApproval" targetRef="endEvent" />

  </process>

  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_leave-form-flow">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_leave-form-flow" bpmnElement="leave-bill">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="startEvent_di" bpmnElement="startEvent">
        <dc:Bounds x="152" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="submitTask_di" bpmnElement="submitTask">
        <dc:Bounds x="240" y="80" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="managerApproval_di" bpmnElement="managerApproval">
        <dc:Bounds x="400" y="80" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="endEvent_di" bpmnElement="endEvent">
        <dc:Bounds x="560" y="102" width="36" height="36" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="flow1_di" bpmnElement="flow1">
        <di:waypoint x="188" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="240" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="flow2_di" bpmnElement="flow2">
        <di:waypoint x="340" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="400" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="flow3_di" bpmnElement="flow3">
        <di:waypoint x="500" y="120" />
        <di:waypoint x="560" y="120" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</definitions>
